name: Zach Cherry
bio:
Zach Cherry (born November 1, 1987) is an American actor and comedian. He is best known for his roles as Woody Thomas on the Amazon Prime series Fallout, Klev in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and Dylan George on the Apple TV+ series Severance, for which he received an Emmy nomination for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series in 2025.
